limits: CONNECT establishment only; no held TLS response-body or HTTP pool shutdown proof.

Curated callback counts do not prove session-loop or MCP cleanup. MCP exact-handle custody remains unverified in all eight cases; only four App Server cases have an independently clean session-loop report.
Exact native internal first-stop/deadline origin is not observed. CONNECT-local readiness and external stop-to-exit timing are checked; global fixture readiness is enforced by unchanged source.
Post-stop publication and callback-admission counters remain unverified.

Sampled Git identities do not identify argv, operation, socket ownership, or every descendant. Two Git generations are retained per case; inner sampler and independent ACK may identify different generations.
ACK generation equality refers to sidecar/observer/case and retained exact observation, not necessarily inner sampler equality.
A-to-B same-process same-home replacement and refresh delivery are separate gates.
GUI automation, slow-storage/backend hold, storage durability and whole-host cleanliness are separate gates.
Every auxiliary connection in this run entered its fixture guard before stop. This run does not exercise or close the earlier early-auxiliary/post-trigger race.
All-mode ACK narrows the independent observation timing race; no native admission or detached-auxiliary ownership proof is inferred.
Diagnostic post-exit observation and final disappearance never repair a failed strict drain. Native returncodes and adopted nonzero statuses are preserved as recorded.
The separate featured postchecker is not substituted for any original gate. Its scope is async-task ownership receipts, not transport/MCP/whole-host cleanliness.
Older final65 failures, single-case diagnostic and later all-mode pass retain their historical source/run scope; this fresh C result neither overwrites nor retroactively repairs them.
Incomplete platform; no new native extraction family counted for featured task custody.
Original independent storage package is reused with newly built host binaries; no new Rust plugin export/build is claimed.
